records.name: Vue UInputText
records.purpose: Single native text input with v-model, invalid/variant/fluid state classes and focus/blur emits.
records.surface: UInputText (Options API SFC InputText.vue, name "UInputText") and createBaseInputText (BaseInputText.ts) plus inputTextStyleModule and InputTextClassesParams (input-text-style.ts). Base factory chain: createBaseX extends createBaseInput (vue-core base-input: size, fluid, variant props, resolvedVariant, resolvedFluid) over createBaseEditableHolder (modelValue, defaultValue, update:modelValue, value-change, dValue, writeValue); because createBaseInput takes no arguments, the factory shadows cx() and mounted() locally over its own style module. The inherited size prop is never read by the template. Declared props: disabled, invalid, name, placeholder (plus inherited size, fluid, variant, modelValue, defaultValue). Emits focus and blur (native event); update:modelValue and value-change come from writeValue on every native input event. Template: one input type="text" bound to dValue with aria-invalid set from invalid; no slots. styleParams passes invalid, fluid (resolvedFluid) and filled (resolvedVariant === "filled"); the root resolver renders u-input-text with p-invalid, u-input-text-fluid and p-variant-filled, so state classes mix u- and p- prefixes. Style module registered as inputtext.

records.name: Vue UTextarea
records.purpose: Native textarea with v-model, invalid/variant/fluid state classes and optional auto-resize.
records.surface: UTextarea (Textarea.vue, name "UTextarea") and createBaseTextarea (BaseTextarea.ts) plus textareaStyleModule and TextareaClassesParams (textarea-style.ts). records.name: Vue UInputMask
records.purpose: Masked text input with token mask, slot character, auto-clear and unmask options.
records.surface: UInputMask (InputMask.vue, name "UInputMask") and createBaseInputMask (BaseInputMask.ts) plus inputMaskStyleModule (input-mask-style.ts). Base factory chain: createBaseX extends createBaseInput (vue-core base-input: size, fluid, variant props, resolvedVariant, resolvedFluid) over createBaseEditableHolder (modelValue, defaultValue, update:modelValue, value-change, dValue, writeValue); because createBaseInput takes no arguments, the factory shadows cx() and mounted() locally over its own style module. The inherited size prop is never read by the template. Declared props: slotChar ("_"), mask, placeholder, autoClear (true), unmask (false), readonly, disabled, invalid, name. Emits focus, blur, keydown, complete ({ originalEvent, value }, only when the mask is completed and not blank) and paste; v-model through writeValue (unmask writes raw characters instead of the formatted buffer). Mask tokens: 9 digit, a letter, * alphanumeric, ? marks the remainder optional, anything else is a literal. The template is a plain input type="text" whose class is cx('root') with no params, so it renders only u-input-mask (display: inline-block); although the style header describes rendering UInputText, the template does not apply the u-input-text class, so no input-text token CSS reaches it. The mask watcher calls initMask only and does not re-sync the buffer from the model value. initMask assigns this.partialPosition, which is not declared in data(). onPaste returns early without emitting paste when readonly, disabled or no mask is set; otherwise it calls preventDefault and emits paste. Style module registered as input-mask. The Aura preset registry has no inputmask key.

records.name: Vue UInputOtp
records.purpose: One-time-code entry rendering one native input per character with paste and arrow-key navigation.
records.surface: UInputOtp (InputOtp.vue, name "UInputOtp") and createBaseInputOtp (BaseInputOtp.ts) plus inputOtpStyleModule (input-otp-style.ts). records.name: Vue UPassword
records.purpose: Password input with strength feedback overlay and optional visibility toggle.
records.surface: UPassword (Password.vue, name "UPassword") and createBasePassword (BasePassword.ts) plus passwordStyleModule and PasswordClassesParams (password-style.ts). Base factory chain: createBaseX extends createBaseInput (vue-core base-input: size, fluid, variant props, resolvedVariant, resolvedFluid) over createBaseEditableHolder (modelValue, defaultValue, update:modelValue, value-change, dValue, writeValue); because createBaseInput takes no arguments, the factory shadows cx() and mounted() locally over its own style module. The inherited size prop is never read by the template. Declared props: feedback (true), toggleMask, promptLabel, weakLabel, mediumLabel, strongLabel, mediumRegex, strongRegex, placeholder, disabled, inputId, ariaLabel, ariaLabelledby, appendTo ("body"). It declares no invalid or name prop and the template renders no aria-invalid. Emits change (the native event, not a { originalEvent, value } object), focus and blur; v-model through writeValue. Template: root div (cx root with filled, fluid, disabled, so p-filled is applied), input, optional toggle svg icons with role="button" and aria-label but only an @click handler (no tabindex or key handler), an overlay with role="dialog" rendered through Portal (UPortal from vue-core overlay) when feedback is on and the overlay is visible, and an always-rendered u-hidden-accessible aria-live span. Strength: strongRegex 3, mediumRegex 2, otherwise 1; Escape is detected on keyup via event.code. The clearIcon class is defined in the style module but no template uses it. The root also emits u-component. Style module registered as password.

records.name: Vue UInputChips
records.purpose: Chip list input that turns typed or pasted text into array entries.
records.surface: UInputChips (InputChips.vue, name "UInputChips") and createBaseInputChips (BaseInputChips.ts) plus inputChipsStyleModule (input-chips-style.ts). Base chain: createBaseInputChips extends createBaseComponent directly (not createBaseInput), so there is no dValue, writeValue or value-change; modelValue (Array) and update:modelValue are implemented manually in the SFC. Declared props: modelValue, max, separator (typed String or Object but used as a string), addOnBlur (default null), allowDuplicate (true), placeholder, invalid, disabled, inputId, ariaLabelledby, ariaLabel. inheritAttrs is false and the template has no $attrs binding, so fallthrough attributes are dropped. Emits update:modelValue, add, remove, focus, blur. The add event carries { originalEvent, value } where value is the full new array, and it is emitted from Enter, the separator key, paste and blur-add (when addOnBlur is true), unlike the React inventory; remove carries the removed item. Template: ul role="listbox" with li role="option" chips, an inline remove button with aria-label, and a text input li disabled when disabled or maxed out; no chip sub-component is used. Paste splits on the separator using non-global replace for the escape sequences and does not enforce max (Enter and the separator key do). onContainerBlur sets focusedIndex to -1 whereas other paths use null. styleParams passes filled but the root resolver only reads disabled, invalid and focused. Style module registered as inputchips.

records.name: Vue UFloatLabel
records.purpose: Label wrapper that floats a slotted label by CSS :has selectors.
records.surface: UFloatLabel (FloatLabel.vue, name "UFloatLabel") and createBaseFloatLabel (BaseFloatLabel.ts) plus floatLabelStyleModule (float-label-style.ts). Base chain: createBaseComponent directly, componentName floatlabel, no v-model. Declared prop: variant (String, default "over"; in, over and on are styled but the value is not validated). No emits. Template: a root span rendering the default slot, class cx('root', { variant }). The float behavior is pure CSS :has() with no JavaScript focus or value tracking. The filled and invalid selectors target input.u-filled, textarea.u-filled, .u-inputwrapper-focus, .u-inputwrapper-filled and .u-invalid, but UInputText and UTextarea render p-invalid, p-variant-filled and p-filled, and no scoped template renders u-inputwrapper, so those selectors do not match those inputs (focus, placeholder and autofill selectors do not depend on classes; UInputChips root renders u-invalid). Style module registered as floatlabel.
